content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

The key to success lies in leveraging decentralized technologies like blockchain and cryptocurrency. By using Bitcoin as a payment method, you can bypass traditional gatekeepers like Stripe and PayPal, ensuring that your business remains operational even when these platforms are unavailable. This approach also provides an added layer of security and transparency, as all transactions are recorded on a public ledger. With the right infrastructure in place, you can focus on creating value for your customers rather than worrying about payment processing.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can start accepting Bitcoin payments, you'll need to set up a few essential components. This includes a digital storefront, a payment gateway, and a system for delivering your ebooks to customers. You'll also need to choose a cryptocurrency exchange or wallet provider to facilitate transactions. Thankfully, there are many user-friendly options available, making it easier than ever to get started. By taking the time to configure these elements correctly, you'll be able to provide a seamless experience for your customers and ensure that your business runs smoothly.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To accept Bitcoin payments, you'll need to integrate a payment gateway like NOWPayments into your digital storefront. This will allow customers to send Bitcoin payments directly to your wallet, which can then be converted into fiat currency if needed. You'll also need to set up a system for delivering your ebooks, which can be achieved using automated tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. By streamlining these processes, you can minimize the risk of errors and ensure that your customers receive their purchases quickly and efficiently.
Break free from Stripe and PayPal limitations.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've configured your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and start accepting Bitcoin payments. This is an exciting milestone, as it marks the beginning of your journey towards financial independence. To process your first transaction, simply share your Bitcoin payment address with customers and wait for the funds to be transferred. You can then use this momentum to drive further sales and growth, secure in the knowledge that your infrastructure is robust and reliable.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your business grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to meet increasing demand. This may involve upgrading your digital storefront, expanding your product offerings, or optimizing your payment and delivery processes for better performance. By leveraging the flexibility and security of blockchain technology, you can adapt to changing market conditions with confidence, knowing that your infrastructure will continue to support your growth and success.

With this kit, you can break free from the limitations of traditional payment platforms and start building a sovereign commerce infrastructure that puts you in control.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: set up your digital storefront, integrate a payment gateway like NOWPayments, configure automated delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, test your payment and delivery pipeline, and go live with your Bitcoin payment address. By following these steps, you can ensure a smooth and successful launch, and start accepting Bitcoin payments from customers around the world.
